classOrderItem.description: Either a bare class name or a section object. Section objects may declare a section name, an explicit list of classes, and/or a tag that pulls in classes annotated with @tag.

classes.description: Class names belonging to this section, in the order they should appear.

collapsed.description: Whether the section is collapsed on page load. Defaults to true.

items.description: Nested subsections or classes. Same shape as the top-level classOrder array.

section.description: Display name of the section. Omit to keep classes at the root level of the sidebar.

tag.description: Name of an @tag. All classes annotated with this tag are added to the section.

description: Configuration file for the Moonwave documentation generator. Every property is optional.

apiCategories.description: Ordered list of @tag names that define categories in each API page's Table of Contents.

autoSectionPath.description: Path to a directory (relative to the project root) whose subfolders will automatically be turned into API sidebar sections. Folder names in kebab-case, snake_case, PascalCase, camelCase, or sentence case are converted to Title Case.

changelog.description: Whether to render a Changelog page from a CHANGELOG.md file in the project root. Defaults to true.

classOrder.description: Controls the order of classes in the API sidebar. Classes not listed here are alphabetized and appended to the end. Listing a class that does not exist is an error.

docusaurus.description: Options forwarded directly to Docusaurus. See https://docusaurus.io/docs/api/docusaurus-config for the full list of supported fields.

baseUrl.description: Base URL the site is served from. Defaults to /{projectName}/.

favicon.description: Path or URL to the favicon image.

onBrokenLinks.description: How to handle broken documentation links. Defaults to "throw".

onBrokenMarkdownLinks.description: How to handle broken Markdown links. Defaults to "warn".

organizationName.description: GitHub user or organization that owns the project. Automatically filled in from Git when omitted.

projectName.description: GitHub project name. Automatically filled in from Git when omitted.

tagline.description: Tagline shown under the site title.

title.description: Document title used for the site.

copyright.description: Copyright text shown in the footer. Defaults to a generated string built from organizationName.

href.description: External URL the link points to.

label.description: Display text for the footer link.

to.description: Internal route the link points to.

gitRepoUrl.description: URL to the Git repository. Automatically filled in from Git when omitted.

gitSourceBranch.description: The main branch name used for 'Edit this page' links. Defaults to "master".

bannerImage.description: URL or path to a banner image displayed at the top of the home page.

enabled.description: When true, renders a Docusaurus home page instead of falling back to README.md.

features.description: Feature cards shown on the home page.

description.description: Body text of the feature card.

image.description: URL or path to the feature card image. Paths starting with "/" are resolved relative to baseUrl.

includeReadme.description: When true, the project's README.md is appended to the home page. When set to a string, that string is used as the path to the README file instead.

navbar.description: Customization for the top navigation bar.

items.description: Extra navbar items appended after the auto-generated Docs, Blog, API, and Changelog entries.

href.description: External URL the item links to. Use this for links outside the site.

label.description: Display text for the navbar item.

position.description: Which side of the navbar the item appears on.

to.description: Internal route the item links to. Use this for links within the site.

logo.description: Logo image shown in the navbar.

alt.description: Alt text for the logo image.

src.description: URL or path to the logo image.

title.description: Title shown in the navbar. Defaults to the project title.
The site's title. Automatically filled in from the Git repository name when omitted.
